title: A mathematical modelling of rheumatoid arthritis
summary: We developed a mathematical model to describe the inflammatory dynamics during arthritis development and resolution, focusing on the interaction between three key immune cell populations within the joint tissue, namely neutrophils (N), sublining synovial tissue-resident macrophages (SL-TRM, T), and circulating monocytes that are recruited into the inflamed joint and differentiate into monocyte-derived macrophages (MoMac, M).
